newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed offering Martin Marietta shares.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed offering Martin Marietta shares.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said Monday its offer to exchange 4.72 Martin Marietta Materials Inc shares for each Lockheed common share tendered, up to a maximum of 7,913,136 Lockheed shares, has started.
The company said the offer is scheduled to expire October 18. It is contingent upon, among other requirements, at least 5,275,424 Lockheed shares being tendered.
That is about 2.6 percent of its outstanding shares, the company noted in an advertisement announcing the offer.
Lockheed's ad said the minimum exchange would result in at least 66 percent of Martin Marietta Materials' stock being distributed to Lockheed shareholders.

The company noted it owns about 81 percent of Martin Materials' outstanding shares and said it is making the exchange offer to facilitate the separation of Martin Marietta Materials' aggregates and magnesia sepcialties operations from Lockheed Martin's core aerospace and defense businesses in a manner that is tax free to stockholders.
Lockheed now has some 200.1 million common shares outstanding. Martin Marietta Materials has over 46 million outstanding shares. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
